a: John Charles Ryle (1816–1900) yali omu ku bakulembeze b'Abevanjulizi abaasinga obuyinza mu Kkanisa y'e Bungereza mu mulembe gwa Vikitoliya era, okuva mu 1880, Omulabirizi omusooka ow'e Liverpool. Yazaalibwa mu maka amagagga ag'ab'ebbanka mu Cheshire, era yamanyikira okusinga byonna olw'empandiika ye ey'Enjiri ey'olwatu era ey'obutereevu, era obupapula bwe bwasaasaanyizibwa mu bukadde mu bulamu bwe era ne buvvuunulwa mu nnimi nnyingi.

q: Obulamu bwa Ryle obw'olubereberye bwali butya nga tannayingira buweereza?
a: Ryle yazaalibwa nga 10 May 1816 mu Macclesfield, mutabani w'omunnaggwanga w'ebbanka era Memba wa Palamenti, era yakulira mu mikisa gyonna egy'ensi n'essuubi ery'omulimu omunene mu by'obufuzi. Yagenda e Eton oluvannyuma e Christ Church, Oxford, gye yali omuzannyi omukugu nga bwe yali omuyivu — yakulembera ekibiina ky'omupiira gwa cricket ekya yunivasite era n'agwisa wickets nnyingi mu mpaka za yunivasite e Lord's — era n'atuuza byonna bwe yafuna diguli ey'omutindo ogusooka mu Classics mu 1837. Fellowship ey'e kolegi, era ne kirabika nga n'entebe mu Palamenti, byali bimulindiridde.

Okukyusibwa kwe kwajja nga mu 1837, mu myaka gye egy'e Oxford ne mu kiseera ky'obulwadde obw'amaanyi obwali bwasooka okumuzza eri Bayibuli n'okusaba. Emirundi mingi yakikwataganya ne Ssande emu bwe yatuuka mu kkanisa nga wasomebwa essuula ey'okubiri ey'Abaefeso, era ebigambo nti "Mwalokolebwa lwa kisa olw'okukkiriza ... kirabo kya Katonda" ne bituuka ku mutima ne bisigalawo. Okuva ku kisa ekyo, bwe yagamba, teyakivaako oluvannyuma.

q: Kya mazima nti okugwa kw'ebbanka kwakyusa olugendo lw'obulamu bwe lwonna?
a: Yee. Mu June 1841 ebbanka ya kitaawe yagwa mu kabi kanene era obugagga bw'amaka ne bugenda mu lunaku lumu; Ryle yawandiika nti "twagolokoka ku makya g'ekiseera ky'ebbugumu ng'ensi yonna eri mu maaso gaffe nga bulijjo, ne tugenda okwebaka ekiro ekyo nga tuzikiridde ddala era ddala." Akabi ako kaaggalawo oluggi ku mulimu gwe yali asuubira mu by'obufuzi, era yaawulibwa okuba omusumba mu mwaka gwe gumu ogwo, ng'akkiriza nti yafuuka omusumba "kubanga nawulira nga nsibiddwa okukikola, so saalaba ngeri ndala yonna ey'obulamu eyali enziguddwawo." Oluvannyuma yasalawo nti byonna byali bya bulungi, ng'agamba nti singa teyazikirira teyandibuulidde kubuulira na kumu wadde okuwandiika akapapula oba ekitabo.

Teyaweereza mu kkanisa nkulu wabula mu bukiise — obuweereza obw'omusumba omuyambi e Exbury mu Hampshire, oluvannyuma Winchester, ate Helmingham, era okumala kumpi emyaka amakumi abiri obuvikaali bwa Stradbroke mu byalo bya Suffolk. Mu bitundu ebyo eby'oku byalo, ng'aweereza abakozi b'oku nnimiro n'abasuubuzi ab'omu maduuka nga bw'aweereza ne mwami, mwe yavumbulira ekirabo kye eky'okufuula Enjiri ennyangu eri abantu aba bulijjo.

q: Lwaki ebiwandiiko bya Ryle bimanyikiddwa nnyo?
a: Ryle yeewaayo okuwandiika obupapula obw'Enjiri obumpi, obw'obutereevu era obutaliiko kuwoomerera obwagenderera abasomi aba bulijjo, era bwagenda mu bukadde, nga buvvuunulwa mu nnimi nnyingi. Yali akakasa nti amazima agagerebwa mu bwangu si mazima gafuuliddwa amayengevu, era nti omukozi ali emabega mu kkanisa yali asaanira okutegeera nga bwe kyali eri omusajja ow'ekitiibwa ali mu ntebe ey'omu maaso. Emyaka egisukka mu kikumi oluvannyuma lw'okufa kwe, obupapula bwe bukyafulumizibwa.

q: Bitabo ki ebya Ryle ebisinga obukulu?
a: Ajjukirwa okusinga olwa Holiness, mwe yanyigiriza nti obutukuvu kibala kyetaagisa era bujulizi bw'obulokozi so si musingi gwabwo, n'olwa Practical Religion, ekyakozesa okukkiriza mu bulamu bw'Ekikristaayo obwa buli lunaku. Ekitabo kye eky'ebitundu ebingi Expository Thoughts on the Gospels, ekyawandiikibwa okusomebwa mu maka, kyatambula olunyiriri ku lunyiriri mu Matayo, Makko, Lukka ne Yokaana, era kikyasomebwa nnyo leero.

q: Ryle yakkiririza mu ki, era yali akendeezezza ku nzikiriza ze?
a: Ryle yali musajja w'ekkanisa Omwevanjulizi era Omuprotestanti omunywevu eyakwata obuyinza obw'olwatu obw'Ebyawandiikibwa, obulokozi olw'ekisa okuyita mu kukkiriza, n'obwetaavu bw'obutukuvu bw'omuntu ssekinnoomu n'okusaba okw'ekyama. Teyanyeenyezebwa nkola ya mulembe wadde kunenyezebwa mu bulamu bwe bwonna, era ne bwe yali ng'atikkiddwa engule y'obulabirizi era ng'alina ekitiibwa, yasigala ddala nga bwe yali afuuse omusumba omuto eyazikirira — omwevanjulizi ow'ekika eky'edda, atagoberera mulembe, atanyeenyezebwa, era ow'olwatu.

q: Ryle yafuuka atya Omulabirizi w'e Liverpool, era kiki kye yakolayo?
a: Mu 1880, ng'aweza emyaka nkaaga mu ena, yalondebwa okuba omulabirizi omusooka ow'edayosizi empya ey'e Liverpool, ku kuteesa kwa Katikkiro Benjamin Disraeli. Mu kifo ky'okuyiwa ssente mu kkanisa nkulu ey'ekitiibwa, yasooka kulaba ng'abasumba be basasulwa bulungi era baweebwa penseni, era ng'ebitundu by'abakozi abaavu bituukiddwako, ng'ayaza abasomi b'Ebyawandiikibwa abataali basumba era ng'akulembera okuzimba amakkanisa amaggya mangi n'ebisenge by'obuweereza. Yawa ekibuga ekyo ekinene eky'omwalo emyaka amakumi abiri egy'omulimu.

q: Nnaku ki Ryle ze yasitula, era obulamu bwe bwakoma butya?
a: Ryle yawasa emirundi esatu era n'afiirwa bakyala emirundi esatu, ng'aziika bakyala be ate ng'akuza abaana be era ng'agenda mu maaso n'obuweereza bwe, era yawandiika ku kubudaabudibwa mu kubonaabona ng'omuntu eyali afunye obuyinza okukikola. Yaleka obulabirizi bwe ku ntandikwa ya 1900, ng'akooye ddala mu myaka gye egy'ekinaana, era n'afa nga wayiseewo emyezi mitono. Ku jjinja lye ery'oku ntaana baawoola olunyiriri olwamukwata emyaka egisukka mu nkaaga emabega — "Mwalokolebwa lwa kisa olw'okukkiriza" — enjigiriza ye yonna mu lunyiriri lumu.
